title: Building a High-Performance 3D Orbital Radar with Three.js and Astro
problemStatement: Rendering real-time 3D telemetry visualization in modern web apps often leads to GPU memory leaks, high frame drops, and battery drain.
whatWillBeBuilt: A 60fps GPU-accelerated interactive 3D orbital radar scanner with responsive aspect ratio, concentric range rings, and automatic context disposal.
architectureOverview: Decoupled WebGL canvas mounting in an Astro client script. Uses custom BufferGeometry, PolarGridHelper, and requestAnimationFrame with visibility API pauses.
explanation: Separating scene initialization from rendering prevents recreation of geometry buffers. Alpha: true enables seamless glassmorphism blending against cosmic gradients.
testing: Validated with Vitest and headless Chromium canvas context mocks. 0 WebGL shader compilation warnings.

troubleshooting.fix: Ensure container has explicit CSS height and width before WebGLRenderer initializes.

securityConsiderations: Strictly sanitize all node labels and telemetry text to prevent DOM-based XSS when projecting 3D tooltips.
performanceOptimization: Limit sphere geometry segments to 16x16. Dispose geometries and materials on unmount.
deployment: Deployable instantly on Cloudflare Pages static edge network with zero server compute required.

title: Building a Zero-Cold-Start Rate-Limited Edge API Proxy on Cloudflare Workers
problemStatement: Exposing backend API endpoints directly to client frontends risks DDoS attacks, credential theft, and sudden billing spikes.
whatWillBeBuilt: A lightweight Edge worker proxy that enforces IP sliding-window rate limiting, strips client tokens, and injects secure backend secrets.
architectureOverview: Cloudflare Worker intercepting fetch events, validating origin headers against allowlists, and querying KV for sliding window counters.
explanation: Running on the edge guarantees sub-10ms latency worldwide while shielding upstream origin servers from abusive traffic bursts.
testing: Executed local Wrangler test suite with 100 concurrent requests; confirmed HTTP 429 after 60 requests.

troubleshooting.fix: Add explicit OPTIONS handler responding with Access-Control-Allow-Origin headers.

securityConsiderations: Secrets stored in Cloudflare encrypted environment variables, never hardcoded in worker scripts.
performanceOptimization: Stream response bodies directly using TransformStreams to eliminate buffering delays.
deployment: Deploy using 'wrangler deploy' directly to Cloudflare Pages Functions or Workers.
